finding.explanation: A docs page has two ThemeControl instances: Header.astro renders one, and the Starlight ThemeSelect component override renders another. They are separate radiogroups but have no form-owner isolation. A name derived only from locale collides across these instances. Existing rendered docs confirm both instances, with previously distinct UUID names.
finding.proposedFix: Use deterministic invocation scope plus locale for the radio name, e.g. header versus sidebar; keep the translated labels/options unchanged.

limits: The existing dist files were read to confirm instance count/call context, not as a fresh artifact of this candidate. No browser/build or product change was performed. The previous complete main linguistic approval report is retained without rebinding this failed candidate.
